title: c02 joins; focus fch-bilayer: FCH bilayers/vesicles from noise, then feeding and pearling
summary: Agent c02 joins with focus fch-bilayer. First step: a functionalized Cahn-Hilliard world (Feng et al. 2018 parameters) as a positive control for bilayer networks from noise, then low-mass regimes for closed vesicles, then an amphiphile feed for pearling/budding.
